title: Seeds, batches and variations in video

questions.q: How does ComfyUI turn a seed into the starting noise for a latent?
options: It seeds the sampling device's generator and draws noise frame by frame
It seeds the CPU generator with torch.manual_seed and draws one Gaussian block for the whole latent, in float32
It hashes the seed into a different seed for every frame
It stores a noise image for each seed
questions.answer: It seeds the CPU generator with torch.manual_seed and draws one Gaussian block for the whole latent, in float32
questions.why: prepare_noise in comfy/sample.py calls torch.manual_seed(seed) and then torch.randn with that generator on the CPU, once for the whole latent, and converts to the latent's dtype.

questions.q: A video is generated with the same seed at 21 latent frames and again at 41. How much of the first noise reappears unchanged in the second?
options: All of it, the first 21 frames are the same
None of it
1/16 of it: channel 0 only, because the noise is laid out channel by channel
Half of it
questions.answer: 1/16 of it: channel 0 only, because the noise is laid out channel by channel
questions.why: The lab prints 0.0625 for the whole latent and 1.0000 for channel 0 alone. Channel 1 starts after all of channel 0's frames, so it shifts when the frame count changes.

questions.q: In the lab, the seeds 5 and 5 + 2^32 give what noise?
options: Different noise, as the seed widget allows 64 bits
Identical noise on this PyTorch build, so the seed has only 2^32 distinct noises
A noise shifted by 2^32 positions
An error
questions.answer: Identical noise on this PyTorch build, so the seed has only 2^32 distinct noises
questions.why: The lab prints True for seed 5 against 5 + 2^32 and against 5 + 2^63, and False against 6. It is an observation about this build's CPU generator.

questions.q: What does LatentBatchSeedBehavior do in its default mode, fixed?
options: It gives every item of the batch the same starting noise
It gives every item independent noise
It freezes the sampler
It repeats the latent four times
questions.answer: It gives every item of the batch the same starting noise
questions.why: It sets batch_index to the first item's index repeated for every item. prepare_noise then uses the same draw for each, and the lab finds all four items identical. In random mode it removes the field.

questions.q: Two nearly orthogonal noises are blended halfway. What is the standard deviation of the result for linear interpolation and for slerp?
options: 1.000 for both
0.708 for linear interpolation, 1.000 for slerp
1.000 for linear interpolation, 0.708 for slerp
0.500 for both
questions.why: A linear blend of two orthogonal vectors of equal length shortens them by √((1 − t)² + t²), 0.707 at t = 0.5. Slerp keeps the length. The sampler expects unit-variance noise.

questions.q: What does the lab say about the correlation between the starting noise of adjacent frames in a ComfyUI video latent?
options: Strong: neighbouring frames share most of their noise
Negative, so frames alternate
None beyond chance: the mean over 20 pairs is -0.0004 and the largest is 0.0065 in size
It depends on the seed
questions.answer: None beyond chance: the mean over 20 pairs is -0.0004 and the largest is 0.0065 in size
questions.why: The whole latent is one block of independent Gaussian numbers. Any coherence between frames in the finished video has to be created by the model.
